sermon.title: Lying Spirit - July 28, 2024
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer), likely Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Ahab gathered 400 prophets who told him what he wanted to hear, while Micaiah alone said whatever the Lord says to me, that I will speak. A lying spirit led Ahab to his death. Today people heap up teachers for itching ears and call God’s word hate; the answer is to consume Christ and have His word written on our hearts.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The recording places the message first and the worship set after it (~45:41). He said “Matthew 24:1” for the false-prophets verse (24:11); left as said. He shortens Micaiah to “Micah” on purpose.
